Source-assisted reading of F-ibi1 (Stams, STA, Frg. 147), made on 1 November 2026 with Paxton's text of Ps.-Siricius (BMCL 13, 1983, p. 6; Google Books snippets), Vat. lat. 1361 fol. 245va-b (page image) and Pfurtscheller 1972, Anhang 1 (Stams Cod. 17 fol. I'r; Google Books snippets) in hand. A research reader reread all lines of both canvases on the image; an independent reader reread canvas 1 lines 9-18 (before and after seeing Vat. lat. 1361) and canvas 0 lines 1-7 (after seeing the Pfurtscheller snippets); the coordinator read canvas 0 lines 5-7. Boxes are native pixels x0,y0,x1,y1. Expansions in parentheses; (?) uncertain; [...] lost or supplied.
